themes_detail.label: Lead Contamination Spike
themes_detail.summary: Lead complaints surged to 19 THIS WEEK—a 424% increase over the 8-week baseline of 3.6 per week—suggesting a possible cluster of lead hazards (paint, water, soil) affecting multiple properties in Sunset Park right now.
evidence: 19 lead complaints THIS WEEK vs. 3.6 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 8.55)
Spike is statistically extreme and emerged suddenly in current week
Lead exposure poses documented risks to children's cognitive development and adult health
reporting_angles: Investigate whether spike is tied to renovation activity (692 DOB permits filed in past 90 days, 467 alterations) that may be disturbing lead-based paint or infrastructure
Interview affected residents and NYC Health Department to determine if cluster is geographic or property-type specific; examine whether City is conducting outreach

themes_detail.label: Tree Health Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Dead and dying tree complaints jumped to 21 THIS WEEK—a 664% spike above the 8-week average of 2.8 per week—pointing to possible disease, pest infestation, or storm damage in the district's urban canopy.
evidence: 21 dead/dying tree complaints THIS WEEK vs. 2.8 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 6.58)
Spike appears concentrated in current week only
Community Board has repeatedly requested park and outdoor amenity expansion, suggesting pre-existing vegetation management gaps
reporting_angles: Contact Parks Department to identify whether spike is tied to a single pathogen, pest outbreak (e.g., emerald ash borer), or recent storm stress
Map complaint locations to determine if tree loss is concentrated in underserved areas where CB has requested park expansion

themes_detail.label: Animal Abuse Reports Surge
themes_detail.summary: Animal abuse complaints hit 6 THIS WEEK—a 220% jump over the 8-week average of 1.9 per week—suggesting possible cases of neglect or cruelty now being reported by residents.
evidence: 6 animal abuse complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 5.28)
First major spike in this category in the dataset period
311 data does not specify whether cases involve dogs, cats, or other animals, or severity
reporting_angles: Contact NYPD and Animal Care & Control to identify nature of complaints (neglect vs. active abuse) and whether they are clustered by neighborhood or location type
Determine if spike coincides with seasonal factors (heat stress on outdoor pets, breeding season) or if it signals a new welfare concern

themes_detail.label: Smoking/Vaping Violations Jump
themes_detail.summary: Smoking and vaping complaints jumped to 5 THIS WEEK—a 400% increase over the 8-week average of 1.0 per week—indicating possible new violations in parks, playgrounds, or public spaces.
evidence: 5 smoking/vaping complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 5.66)
Spike is sudden and concentrated in current week
NYC has expanded smoke-free zones in parks and near playgrounds; enforcement data would clarify whether violations are increasing
reporting_angles: Verify whether spike correlates with warm weather increasing public park use
Contact Parks Enforcement Patrol to assess whether complaints reflect actual enforcement gaps or improved resident reporting

themes_detail.label: Mobile Food Vendor Complaints
themes_detail.summary: Mobile food vendor complaints spiked to 3 THIS WEEK—a 1,100% increase from a baseline of 0.2 per week—suggesting new unlicensed vending or code violations in the district.
evidence: 3 mobile food vendor complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 6.35)
Very small baseline makes percentage spike high, but absolute numbers remain small
311 data does not specify whether violations involve licensing, sanitation, or location/permit issues
reporting_angles: Contact Department of Health to determine whether spike reflects increased unlicensed vending or enforcement action against existing vendors
Assess whether complaints are tied to a specific location or vendor, or represent broader street vending activity
